purpose: Controlled Phase 4K0 action IDs for a fast non-LLM selector. The selector may choose an action_id only; response rendering, product truth, verification, memory, and side effects remain owned by runtime.

labels.description: Orient the buyer to plan categories or available option families without selecting a plan.
required_context: buyer asks for plan overview or categories
forbidden_when: buyer asks direct pricing
buyer gave enough context for a recommendation
safety_notes: Renderer must use campaign-owned facts only.

labels.description: Explain the distinction between a subscription tier and a model name.
positive_examples: Is GPT-4o the same as Plus?
What is the difference between model and subscription?
required_context: buyer confuses model access and subscription plan
forbidden_when: buyer asks about unrelated provider internals
safety_notes: Do not invent model availability.

labels.description: Answer source, recommendation basis, or affiliation questions.
positive_examples: Where is this recommendation coming from?
required_context: buyer asks source or affiliation
forbidden_when: buyer asks privacy or data retention
safety_notes: Do not claim affiliation not present in campaign facts.

labels.description: Ask what the buyer wants to solve or where the current setup falls short.
negative_examples: I use it every day for coding.
required_context: current tool or intensity known but use-case gap remains unknown
forbidden_when: buyer already gave use case and objects to repetition
safety_notes: Ask only one next question.

labels.description: Ask how frequent or deep the intended use is.
positive_examples: I need it for coding and voice.
negative_examples: I code daily and hit limits.
I already told you, coding and voice.
required_context: use case is known and intensity is unknown
forbidden_when: intensity is already known
safety_notes: Preserve voice versus writing distinction.

labels.description: Ask whether the buyer currently uses ChatGPT or another AI tool.
positive_examples: I am looking at AI tools.
required_context: adoption state is missing and needed before plan fit
forbidden_when: buyer already named a current tool
safety_notes: Do not treat adoption state as product truth.

labels.description: Clarify an ambiguous tool or ASR-confused tool name.
positive_examples: I use cloud, or Claude, not sure.
required_context: tool name is ambiguous
forbidden_when: tool name is unambiguous
safety_notes: Do not silently rewrite buyer wording.

labels.description: Clarify a vague or confused buyer question before choosing a sales move.
positive_examples: I am confused. What are you asking me?
required_context: buyer confusion or ambiguous question scope
forbidden_when: buyer asked a clear direct question
safety_notes: Keep clarification narrow.

labels.description: Clarify or adapt to individual versus team use.
positive_examples: I am by myself, not a team.
required_context: team state is stated or contradicted
forbidden_when: buyer is clearly asking for enterprise/team controls
safety_notes: Preserve not-team correction.

labels.description: Answer a direct price or cost question.
required_context: buyer asks direct price
forbidden_when: buyer is objecting to value rather than asking price
safety_notes: Renderer must use campaign-owned pricing facts.

labels.description: Compare Plus against Pro for fit or sufficiency.
required_context: buyer asks Plus versus Pro or Plus sufficiency
forbidden_when: buyer asks direct price only
safety_notes: Do not invent limits or feature claims.

labels.description: Compare or explain Pro-tier choice when the buyer asks about Pro specifically.
required_context: buyer asks about Pro choice
forbidden_when: team or enterprise need dominates
safety_notes: Renderer must avoid unsupported tier details.

labels.description: Recommend or keep buyer on Plus when context supports Plus-level fit.
positive_examples: Is Plus enough for light use?
negative_examples: I code daily and hit limits.
required_context: low or moderate individual use, no team controls, no heavy limit pressure
forbidden_when: heavy daily use or team requirements are known
safety_notes: Recommendation must stay renderer-owned.

labels.description: Recommend Pro when individual heavy use or limit pressure is known.
positive_examples: I code daily and hit limits, recommend one.
Every day for coding and voice; pick a plan.
required_context: heavy individual use or limit pressure
forbidden_when: buyer is a no-fit or team procurement case
safety_notes: Do not claim guaranteed capacity.

labels.description: Route team, business, security, SSO, procurement, or enterprise context toward business or enterprise handling.
positive_examples: We need SSO and legal review.
negative_examples: I am by myself, not a team.
required_context: team or enterprise context
forbidden_when: buyer explicitly says not team or personal only
safety_notes: Do not overclaim enterprise features.

labels.description: Acknowledge that the offer is not a fit and avoid pushing.
required_context: buyer states no fit, wrong product, or no interest
forbidden_when: buyer still asks a fit or price question
safety_notes: Do not pressure a no-fit buyer.

labels.description: Handle price or value objection without inventing value claims.
required_context: buyer challenges price or value
forbidden_when: buyer asks a direct factual price question
safety_notes: Renderer must use approved value framing only.

labels.description: Handle another AI tool or competitor comparison context.
positive_examples: I already have another AI tool.
required_context: buyer asks competitor/value comparison
forbidden_when: tool name is ambiguous and needs clarification first
safety_notes: Do not make unsupported competitor claims.

labels.description: Answer signup, starting, or upgrade-path questions.
negative_examples: Can you buy it for me?
required_context: buyer asks signup path
forbidden_when: buyer asks the agent to perform purchase side effects
safety_notes: Do not claim purchase or account changes happened.

labels.description: Answer plan-change or upgrade-later questions.
positive_examples: Can I start lower and upgrade later?
required_context: buyer asks about changing plan later
forbidden_when: buyer asks for current account side effects
safety_notes: Renderer must use campaign-owned account facts.

labels.description: Answer privacy, data retention, transcript, or call-data boundary questions.
positive_examples: Do you store what I say?
Can I see the raw transcript?
negative_examples: Can you buy Plus for me?
required_context: buyer asks privacy or transcript boundary
forbidden_when: buyer asks affiliation only
safety_notes: Do not expose raw private transcript or unsupported data policy.

labels.description: Respect unsupported side-effect, policy, raw URL, or operational boundaries.
positive_examples: Can you buy Plus for me?
required_context: buyer asks for unsupported action or boundary-sensitive output
forbidden_when: there is a safe factual answer with no boundary request
safety_notes: Must keep side_effects_allowed false.

labels.description: Repair after buyer says they already provided the requested information.
positive_examples: I already told you, coding and voice.
required_context: buyer objects to repeated question
forbidden_when: no repeated-question signal and no known prior slot
safety_notes: Use memory; do not repeat the same question.

labels.description: Repair after buyer corrects a misunderstood fact, tool, team state, or use case.
positive_examples: No, I said Claude, not cloud.
Not for a team, just me.
negative_examples: I am by myself, not a team.
required_context: buyer correction marker is present
forbidden_when: no correction or contradiction is present
safety_notes: Preserve corrected buyer wording.

labels.description: Repair uncertain speech recognition or ambiguous heard words.
positive_examples: I use cloud, or Claude, not sure.
Did you mean cloud or Claude?
required_context: ASR ambiguity or uncertain tool name
forbidden_when: buyer intent is clear enough
safety_notes: Do not pretend certainty.

labels.description: Avoid repeating the same question or answer when no new information arrived.
negative_examples: I already told you, coding and voice.
required_context: repeat-risk signal or same last action without new buyer info
forbidden_when: new useful buyer info is present
safety_notes: Move forward using known state.

labels.description: Close politely after buyer acceptance, thanks, or terminal acknowledgement.
positive_examples: Ok, I will check that, thanks.
required_context: buyer acceptance or terminal close marker
forbidden_when: buyer asks a new substantive question
safety_notes: No side effects or follow-up claims.
